I will put fertilizer on this maize plot if I can get the subsidy, because maize is my main food and this piece is small enough for me to concentrate inputs on it. I will use improved seed, and I can also add some manure from home, but I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains here in Ntchisi. I do not usually use pesticide on maize, and most of the work will be done by my family, with only a few hired days if we are short at planting or weeding time.
